crossRefs.note: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.
Moses said to his father-in-law, “Because the people come to me to inquire of God.
There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on…
They put him in custody until Yahweh’s will should be declared to them.
I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

people.name: Moses

translations.web: Moses brought their cause before Yahweh.

translations.kjv: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD.
translations.asv: And Moses brought their cause before Jehovah.
